description: This Java interface defines the ExternalMessage, a wrapper around headers and payload for external AMQP messages, including methods for manipulating headers, payloads, and retrieving message metadata.

classes.name: ExternalMessage
classes.description: An interface representing external AMQP messages, providing methods for header and payload management, and message metadata access.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers of the ExternalMessage as a Map.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage instance including the provided header key and value.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage instance including additional headers.

methods.name: withTopicPath
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with the specified TopicPath.

methods.name: findContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the Content-Type header value if present.

methods.name: findHeader
methods.description: Looks up the specified header key, case-sensitive.

methods.name: findHeaderIgnoreCase
methods.description: Looks up the specified header key, case-insensitive.

methods.name: isTextMessage
methods.description: Indicates if the message is a text message.

methods.name: isBytesMessage
methods.description: Indicates if the message is a bytes message.

methods.name: getTextPayload
methods.description: Returns the text payload if available.

methods.name: getBytePayload
methods.description: Returns the byte payload if available.

methods.name: getPayloadType
methods.description: Retrieves the payload type of the message.

methods.name: isResponse
methods.description: Indicates if the message is a response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Indicates if the message signals an error.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Retrieves the AuthorizationContext associated with the message.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the TopicPath assigned to this message.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Returns enforcement filter data if enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns header mapping info, if present.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns payload mapping info, if present.

methods.name: getSourceAddress
methods.description: Returns the optional source address where the message was received.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source object where the message was received.

methods.name: getInternalHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves internal Ditto headers associated with message creation.
